description: Exact nine-mode exterior-basis replay. A case is one choice of parent chronology, commit chronology, pair creator order, record and flip. Numerators are listed by settings then outcomes, both 000 to 111. For each case, setting 0 is Z, setting 1 is F, and outcome 0 is +1.

fixed_initial_states.explanation: Keeping either of these physical states fixed while changing the coordinate listing leaves its whole row of commit tables fixed.

full_local_case_index.description: Each parent/commit key has a flattened 8×8×8 list of 64-cell table IDs. Pair, record and flip are in the listed axis orders, with flips the fastest varying axis.
